newsitem.title: UK: PowerGen says talks on coal deals continue.
newsitem.headline: PowerGen says talks on coal deals continue.

text.p: British electricity generator PowerGen Plc said on Thursday it was in discussions with RJB Mining Plc and other suppliers over coal contracts but that prices would have to be competitive to secure a deal.
"We are in discussions currently with those suppliers," managing director Deryk King said.
"But those suppliers will have to be fully competitive if we are to buy from them," he added.
Last month, rumours that RJB had failed to secure new contracts with PowerGen to replace existing ones which run out in March 1998 sent its share price lower.
RJB, which incorporates many of the assets of the previously state-owned British Coal, has long term contracts to supply PowerGen and National Power at guaranteed prices above world market levels.
Analysts have said that prices would have to be shaved by as much as 25 percent to persuade PowerGen to renew contracts.
PowerGen has already signed contracts with other mining companies to cover between a third and half of its 1998 needs, newspaper reports have said.
